data.one_liner: A Flutter ListView widget where list items can be grouped into sections.
data.what_it_does: Provides a GroupedListView and SilverGroupedListView that automatically segment items into sections based on a grouping function. Supports custom headers, footers, sticky headers, and sorting for both items and groups.
use_when: You need to display a list of items categorized into groups with section headers
You want support for sticky group headers or chat-style reverse lists
avoid_when: You only need a standard ungrouped ListView or a complex grid layout
strengths: Easy creation of chat dialogs and grouped sections
Supports sticky group headers and floating headers
Provides multiple builder options like indexedItemBuilder and interdependentItemBuilder
weaknesses: Some options of GroupedListView are currently not available in SilverGroupedListView
data.minimal_example:
GroupedListView<dynamic, String>(
    elements: _elements,
    groupBy: (element) => element['group'],
    groupSeparatorBuilder: (String groupByValue) => Text(groupByValue),
    itemBuilder: (context, dynamic element) => Text(element['name']),
  )
